sources.adp: Fantasy Football Calculator 2026 14-team half-PPR ADP REST API
sources.scoring: Custom Yahoo half-PPR league scoring supplied by league owner

notes.projectionMethod: Public consensus rows are rescored to league settings; deeper players use a position-specific curve calibrated to those anchors and current 14-team half-PPR ADP.
notes.kickerProjection: Kicker values are approximate because distance/miss buckets are unavailable in the public consensus row.
notes.defenseProjection: D/ST values are approximate because all Yahoo scoring components are not present in the public consensus row.
